question: 円安と海外の実質購買力・物価・貿易構造を踏まえ、日本からどの市場・商品カテゴリへ輸出余地が生まれうるか

baseline.description: Observed trade, FX and price levels as of 2026-06-30

scenarios.title: FX advantage lowers landed EUR price and Japanese quantity/share rises

assumptions.statement: JPY/EUR depreciated versus the 2021 average as of the baseline
Exporters pass the FX gain through to EUR prices

mechanisms: weaker yen -> lower EUR unit value -> higher quantity

expectations.indicator: COMEXT EU import quantity from Japan (HS 84,85)
expectations.statement: Import quantity from Japan rises over the window
expectations.falsificationCondition: EU import quantity from Japan flat or falling while EUR unit value falls

expectations.indicator: COMEXT EUR unit value of imports from Japan
expectations.falsificationCondition: EUR unit value unchanged or rising

scenarios.title: FX advantage exists but shipping and tariff costs absorb it

assumptions.statement: JPY/EUR depreciated versus the 2021 average as of the baseline
Container freight rates stay above the 2019 level

expectations.indicator: Landed EUR price index incl. freight and TARIC duty
expectations.falsificationCondition: landed EUR price falls by more than the FX move net of freight

scenarios.title: Purchasing power weakens and consumers substitute toward cheaper imports

assumptions.statement: EU real disposable income declines over the window

expectations.indicator: Japan share of EU extra imports in discretionary categories
expectations.statement: Japan share falls while non-Japan low-price share rises
expectations.falsificationCondition: Japan share rises while real income falls

scenarios.title: Purchasing power weakens and discretionary demand falls including Japanese imports

assumptions.statement: EU real disposable income declines over the window

expectations.indicator: EU total discretionary import value (all origins)

scenarios.title: Demand rises for category-specific reasons unrelated to FX

assumptions.statement: A category-specific demand driver exists independent of FX

expectations.indicator: EU imports of the category from non-Japan origins
expectations.statement: Imports from all origins rise together
expectations.falsificationCondition: only imports from Japan rise while other origins stay flat

relations.note: S3 predicts falling Japan share with stable total demand; S4 predicts falling total demand
landed price either falls or does not
